headline: FBI reportedly probing apparent hack of criminal database
pages: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center database, US media reported, citing two people briefed on the matter. The system lets federal and local law enforcement share information on warrants and background checks. The BBC contacted the FBI for comment. The report follows a string of tech outages last week that hit banking and air traffic control; officials say those were not caused by cyberattacks, but lawmakers have asked questions. White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was fired this week, with President Trump saying he was not good enough.

NBC separately reported an apparent cyberattack on the US Department of Agriculture's farm payment system, which staff were told about on Thursday. The USDA has not commented. In September the FBI said it was investigating a breach by a group called ShinyHunters that claimed to have stolen data on about 38,000 bureau staff. Source: BBC.
